output.technical_predicate: Optional "repayment insights" processing is gated on a purpose-specific, affirmative, versioned consent record for purpose "insights"; a "promotions" choice must not satisfy that gate; the core application (application submission, case handling) must remain usable with insights off.
applicability_facts: Scenario: adult EU-established private controller; core application used with optional repayment insights initially off.
store.py:0088-0090 enabled() reads the latest choices row for the exact (owner, purpose) pair, so insights and promotions are separate purposes.
store.py:0092-0095 preference() accepts only purposes insights/promotions/objection and values on/off, and writes a versioned record (version=VERSION, store.py:0011) with timestamp.
store.py:0137-0139 the 'report' (insights) job runs only if enabled(owner,'insights'); store.py:0167-0168 the report action requires enabled(who,'insights').
store.py:0100-0103 campaign eligibility uses only the 'promotions' purpose (plus objection), never 'insights'.
views.py:0033-0036 renders separate per-purpose switch forms for insights, promotions and objection; views.py:0031-0032 application form does not require any consent checkbox.
store.py:0065-0083 submit() requires no insights consent; core application path is independent of choices.
relevant_exceptions: No exception relied on: the requirement is a consent-gating predicate, not a prohibition subject to Art. 9/23-style derogations.
Withdrawal (switch off) is handled by appending a new 'off' choice row (store.py:0094-0098), which the latest-row read in enabled() honors; this is a control, not an exception.
required_controls: Purpose separation: insights gate must read only the 'insights' purpose (store.py:0088-0090, 0137, 0168).
Affirmative opt-in: default state is off (no choices row => enabled() False, store.py:0088-0090); enabling requires an explicit 'on' submission (views.py:0036, store.py:0093).
Versioned record: each choice stores version and timestamp (store.py:0094-0095, schema store.py:0042).
Promotions must not authorize insights: campaign/eligibility path uses 'promotions' only (store.py:0100-0103, 0140).
Core availability without consent: application submission and case handling do not depend on insights consent (store.py:0065-0083; views.py:0031-0032).
Withdrawal as easy as grant: symmetric on/off switch per purpose (views.py:0034-0036) and queued report jobs cancelled on 'off' (store.py:0096-0098).
assessment_limits: Static source reading only; no execution, no runtime or database inspection performed.
No assessment of whether the consent UI text meets Art. 7(2) intelligibility beyond the presence of separate per-purpose controls.
No assessment of other GDPR obligations (Art. 6(1)(b) contract basis, Art. 22 automated decisions, retention) beyond the named insights-consent predicate.
No inference about upstream or hidden implementation; only the supplied app.py, store.py, views.py, style.css are considered.
Whether a real user actually toggled insights on is a runtime fact not established by the snapshot; only the code-level gate is assessed.
